_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + ethanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set without ionic liquid from Zhang et al. (2017). Used as an independent check, not in the fit. Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethyl acetate.

source.citation: Z. Zhang, K. Wu, Q. Zhang, T. Zhang, D. Zhang, R. Yang, W. Li, Separation of ethyl acetate and ethanol azeotrope mixture using dialkylphosphates-based ionic liquids as entrainers, Fluid Phase Equilibria 454 (2017) 91-98
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record: the binary ethyl acetate + ethanol data sets (boiling temperature and vapour mole fraction) without ionic liquid. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the ThermoML record: T 0.13-0.14 K, y_1 0.004-0.005. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files); the second JSON read first mixed up the temperature list and was repeated; the repeated read and the XML read are identical.
